title: Dereth Town Tour - Eastwatch scratch

shots.standingOrder: Rise from 100 m to 184 m over the sea 55-80 m off the east cliff while easing 25 m toward it, until the plateau edge drops away and the outpost appears; stay 50 m from the cliff face.
shots.notes: ESTABLISHING REVEAL (drone.rising-reveal). Starts over open sea 140 m east of the outpost, 100 m up, facing the sunlit 170 m ice-and-rock sea cliff 80 m ahead; rises 84 m in 16 s while drifting 25 m forward and pitching from -11 to -8 deg until it clears the crest at x 14183: the lighthouse towers, keep and plateau of Eastwatch appear over the edge with the frozen Isle of Ruin behind. 100 % over water (ground 0); ends 62 m from the east lighthouse. Verified offline (real registry build + WBT terrain): start (14263.5,46127.8,100.0) end (14238.6,46130.0,184.0), min AGL 100.0 m, nearest static/building/tree 61.7 m (0x49F0#20 0x010036EA), peak 8.6 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Stand locked 2 m above the snow south of the keep, hold on the west lighthouse, then whip right to land on the east lighthouse.
shots.notes: GRAMMAR (classic.whip-pan between the two lighthouses). Camera at (14124,46093,171.7), 1.7 m above the plateau south of the keep: holds on the west lighthouse (bearing 316), whips 110 deg right in 0.3 s at mid-shot and lands on the east lighthouse at the cliff edge (bearing 66) with the sea beyond. Both lines of sight pass clear of the keep (16 m away). Verified offline (real registry build + WBT terrain): start (14124.0,46093.0,171.7) end (14124.0,46093.0,171.7), min AGL 1.7 m, nearest static/building/tree 16.0 m (0x49F0#17 0x010036E3), peak 0.0 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Push 2 m toward the keep's north door from 15 m out at eye height, looking up past the two blue-flame lamps to the golden roof; stay 3 m from the signpost and lamps.
shots.notes: BLUE FLAME FX + LANDMARK (classic.low-angle). Camera 1.8 m above the plaza 15 m north of the keep-tower, pitched up 23 deg: the two golden lamps with tall blue flame tongues flank the door in the shaded north face (sun on the far side), the stone tower climbs to its golden tapered roof against the sky; slow 2 m push. Nearest lamp 6 m behind the camera. Verified offline (real registry build + WBT terrain): start (14124.0,46138.0,171.8) end (14124.0,46136.1,172.6), min AGL 1.8 m, nearest static/building/tree 3.5 m (Eastwatch Outpost), peak 0.2 m/s.

shots.standingOrder: Fly back 14 to 55 m from the east lighthouse along bearing 240 at 13 m height while zooming in so the tower keeps its size and the sea horizon swells behind it.
shots.notes: VERTIGO (drone.vertigo-drone on a tower). Camera at z 183 (mid-tower, 13 m above the plateau) retreats WSW from 14 to 55 m while the fov narrows 60 -> 17 deg: the lighthouse holds its size while the sea, the ice spires and the horizon behind it loom and compress. Path passes 20 m south of the keep; ground 168-170. shots.standingOrder: Run east 7 m over the plateau, crest the cliff edge and dive the 170 m sea cliff at -80 degrees, pulling out 4 m above the ice between the rocks; FPV speed, keep 7 m from the ice rocks.
shots.notes: SPECTACLE (fpv.fpv-dive, FPV preset, peak 18.7 m/s). Level approach at z 177 (7 m above the plateau), crest at x 14211, near-vertical dive down the sea cliff (dive line 28 m off the face) and pull-out into level flight 4 m above the ice shelf and sea, threading between the 8.6 m and 12.2 m ice rocks (7.5 m clear) toward open water. JEV-eligible hero candidate.
